Carve
20 Energy
Channeled
Requires Polearms, Staves, Two-Handed Axes, Two-Handed Maces, Two-Handed Swords
Consumes 2 Felfury
Charge up a powerful attack over 2.5 sec.

Upon ending the channel, slash in front of you, dealing increased Weapon Damage with both weapons based on how long you channel, dealing less damage with each target struck.

Inner Demon: Reduces affected enemies melee and ranged haste by 20% for 8 sec.

Can dodge and parry while channeling and you can channel while moving.
